nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: I can't believe there's a real wonderbolt in town!

nodes.speaker: wonderbolt
nodes.text: That's the one. My name is Soarin.

nodes.speaker: wonderbolt
nodes.text: If, Celestia forbid, something dangerous happen, you know, who to call.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: And if, Luna forbid, your throat gets dry, now you know which bar to go to.

nodes.speaker: wonderbolt
nodes.text: Oh, so you are our new barpony?

nodes.speaker: wonderbolt
nodes.text: May... maybe, you sell pies besides drinks?

nodes.speaker: wonderbolt
nodes.text: Think about adding them to the menu. You will definitely have at least one regular customer.
